description: Changes data (creates a project); needs sign-in. Save a recommended stack, or an audit of an existing app, to the signed-in user's Kong Reviews account so it can be reopened later and compared with current prices. Pass the share_url from recommend_stack, plan_stack or audit_stack (preferred) or the plan_stack arguments, plus a short name such as "Yoga booking MVP". Afterwards, offer update_saved_stack with alerts: true so they are emailed when prices or cost jumps change it. Needs sign-in: if the user isn't signed in, the app will ask them to connect their Kong Reviews account. Only save when the user asks to keep or save a stack.

name.description: Short name the user will recognise.

plan.description: plan_stack arguments (recommend_stack returns them as plan_stack_arguments). With share_url, they are what is kept, so each requirement's source sentence survives; without, they are the plan.

share_url.description: share_url returned by recommend_stack, plan_stack or audit_stack.

name: save_stack

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Save a stack to your account
